desc:
RoMusic V2 Enjoy a YouTube Music–style interactive music player inside Roblox. Listen to the best Phonk & Funk tracks with a modern dark interface fully optimized for PC and mobile devices.

✨ Features:

Dynamic playlist with track selection.
Play, Pause, Previous & Next controls.
Repeat mode.
Interactive progress bar (seek forward & backward).
Song cover, artist name, and live time display.
Mobile compatible 📱.

For some reasons, Roblox does not accept around 80% of Funk/Phonk songs due to platform rules. Because of this, we use slightly modified music that fully follows Roblox guidelines while keeping a similar sound.Thank you for your understanding.
Goodbye! Adding new songs and updates every week.
